title: CROPseq_KO150_A1_ADT_HTO
data_processing: Raw basecalls from the sequencer were demultiplexed and converted to FASTQ format using the 10x Genomics' Cell Ranger (3.0.2) command “mkfastq”.

FASTQ files were then aligned to the mouse reference genome assembly GRCm38 (mm10), and count matrices were generated for each sample based on genome annotation v93 using the Cell Ranger command “count”.
Assembly: mm10
Supplementary files format and content: raw and filtered feature barcode matrices: .h5 archives of CellRanger output
Supplementary files format and content: feature_reference.csv: comma-separated feature reference file for ADT, HTO, GDO quantification and annotation
Library strategy: CROP-seq
